build_condition_encoder: build an AceStepConditionEncoder to fuse text, lyric, and timbre conditioning into a packed sequence for the DiT cross-attention
create_audio_tokenizer: create an AceStepAudioTokenizer to convert 25 Hz acoustic latents into 5 Hz audio tokens using residual FSQ quantization
create_audio_detokenizer: create an AceStepAudioTokenDetokenizer to expand 5 Hz audio tokens back to 25 Hz acoustic conditioning
create_lyric_encoder: create an AceStepLyricEncoder to project Qwen3 lyric embeddings through a transformer with sliding and full attention layers
create_timbre_encoder: create an AceStepTimbreEncoder to consume VAE-encoded reference audio latents and return pooled per-batch timbre embeddings
